live.name: NICKEL HYATT
live.headline: NICKEL HYATT: a threat actor known by many names
live.in_short: NICKEL HYATT is the Secureworks name for an actor also tracked as APT45 and Andariel. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: NICKEL HYATT is the name Secureworks uses for this threat actor.
It is also tracked under other names, including APT45, Andariel, Dark Seoul, Jumpy Pisces, Onyx Sleet, RIFLE Campaign, Silent Chollima, Stonefly and UN614.
The catalogue lists these tools for the actor: ActiveX 0-day, DTrack, HazyLoad, HotCriossant, Rifle, UnitBot and Valefor.
No public report in this library describes its operations.

next.headline: NICKEL HYATT (Andariel): a North Korea-linked group known for ransomware and financial theft
next.in_short: NICKEL HYATT, also tracked as Andariel and APT45, is a North Korea-nexus actor. CrowdStrike assesses it is likely tied to a state intelligence bureau. Reports note custom ransomware used for financial theft.

sentences.t: NICKEL HYATT is the Secureworks name for a threat actor that is also tracked as APT45, Andariel, Dark Seoul, Jumpy Pisces, Onyx Sleet, Silent Chollima, Stonefly and UN614.
CrowdStrike tracks it as SILENT CHOLLIMA and describes it as a North Korea-nexus adversary active since at least 2007.
CrowdStrike assesses it is likely affiliated with Lab 110 within Bureau 3 of North Korea's General Reconnaissance Information Bureau (GRIB). The vendor states this as likely, not confirmed.
CrowdStrike lists its objectives as financial gain, intellectual property theft, intelligence gathering and destruction.

Kudelski Security and Sekoia note that affiliation of these clusters to the 3rd or 5th Bureau is debated among threat intelligence analysts. They also say aliases proliferate and vendors divide clusters differently.
Kudelski Security and Sekoia say Andariel is unusual because it used custom ransomware, Maui and H0lyGh0st, for financial theft.
The catalogue lists these tools for the group: ActiveX 0-day, DTrack, HazyLoad, HotCriossant, Rifle, UnitBot and Valefor.
A public code repository describes a PHP server emulator as a tool for SHATTEREDGLASS ransomware attributed to Andariel. The page holds no threat analysis.
